items.question: Who governs humans and the social class order within the descending hierarchy?
premises: Higher beings govern lower beings in a descending hierarchy.
Humans are governed by other humans.
The social class order is governed by the best twice-born.
items.inference: The hierarchical chain of governance extends analogously to humans and their social class order.
uncertainties: Whether varṇasaṃsthā refers specifically to the fourfold varṇa system or more generally to social arrangement.
items.plain_english: Likewise, humans are governed by humans, and the social class order is governed by the best of the twice-born.
